title: Sustainable multicomponent synthesis of C-4 sulfenylated pyrazoles via sodium thiosulfate-promoted tandem cyclocondensation and C–H sulfenylation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40737-40744
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07282D, Paper

A sustainable domino multicomponent protocol enables the synthesis of C-4 sulfenylated pyrazoles via simultaneous pyrazole ring construction and C–H sulfenylation in a single operation under mild conditions.
